description.value:
Black Bird Manipulation — Cursed Technique Reversal

With your mastery of Reverse Cursed Technique, you have learned Black Bird Manipulation's reversal. You are now able to tame Doves for 2 CE. As a bonus action, you can turn an amount of Crows equal to your CE modifier into Doves, spending 2 CE per Crow. Doves operate and follow the same rules as Crows but cannot be used for Bird Strike. As part of controlling a Dove, you can spend cursed energy up to twice your CE modifier to heal a creature within 5 ft of the Dove by sacrificing the Dove. The creature regains 1d8 hit points per Cursed Energy spent. While any allies are within 30 ft of a Dove, they have advantage on saving throws against the Frightened and Charmed conditions. If any allied creatures within range are reduced to 0 hit points or making death saves, they are instead stabilized. Additionally, a Dove can suppress an effect causing a creature within range to be Charmed or Frightened. If the Dove leaves the 30 ft radius of that creature, any suppressed effect resumes.

system.requirements: Cursed Technique Reversal, Black Bird Manipulation
